patches.title: Full-block route matches only /blocks/{id}, so the input-block transaction routes are reachable
patches.origin: upstream PR by A. Shannon (not ours), the BlocksApiRoute hunk only; the same one-line change is arkadianet/ergo-scala#17 commit d6cd348e0
patches.fixes: /blocks/{id}/inputBlockTransactionIds and /inputBlockTransactions answer 404 for every input block: the full-block route matches /blocks/{id}/<anything> first
patches.witness: route probe on a1bd938ef + this patch: 72 of 72 input-block id lookups answered a list (unpatched: 0 of 70, all 404, while the node log applied transactions for all 70 ids); matrix-tx 3/3 PASS (unpatched 3/3 FAIL); 2026-09-25
responses: 2026-09-25: #2505 head moved to 4138875ba5; the route hunk is unchanged

patches.title: Relay a received input block by id to eligible sub-block peers (receive-side guard + relay)
patches.fixes: input blocks reach only the miner's own peers (issue #2565)
patches.witness: unit: ErgoNodeViewSynchronizerSpecification per commit (95, 96 pass; each commit reverted: its properties fail); network: matrix-latency 3/3 PASS on a1bd938ef + this diff (C 207, 202, 205 input blocks; none without), matrix-pair PASS

patches.title: Key V2 sync summaries by selected tip and requested mode (#2511, as patches/ergo/001)
patches.origin: upstream PR by A. Shannon (not ours); production diff only
patches.fixes: a follower that never switches to the heavier chain after a partition heals
patches.witness: release line: fork-convergence A/A 23 of 23 switched; Matrix line: matrix-fork 1 of 2 valid runs converged, a rate is not yet measured

patches.title: Full V2 sync summaries also carry the genesis header, so a peer always finds a common point
patches.origin: upstream work by A. Shannon (not ours): the ErgoHistoryReader.syncInfoV2 hunk of ergoplatform/ergo#2511 at its earlier head 8c00df3a98, dropped when #2511 was narrowed to the cache keying; the same hunk is in ergoplatform/ergo#2529 (a-shannon, open) at 561e5c3a40, verified 2026-09-26
patches.fixes: a node on a fork deeper than 16 blocks on a young chain (height <= 128) sends sync summaries (tip, tip-16) that are all on its own fork; the peer finds no common point, answers with an empty continuation ('Extension is empty while comparison is younger'), and the node never learns the heavier chain
patches.witness: matrix-fork on the Matrix stack: without it deep-fork runs 0/4 PASS (fork depth 22-28, every FAIL LIGHTER_FORK_NOT_SWITCHING), shallow 4/4; with it 7/7 valid PASS, deep 5/5 (depth 21-28), shallow 2/2 (1 INCONCLUSIVE: the example's disjoint-genesis race, fixed separately); 2026-09-25
patches.route: upstream in #2529; no separate PR needed

patches.title: Preserve Matrix transaction classification and ordering fee (the miner no longer drops a payment that spends an earlier payment's unconfirmed change)

patches.fixes: on weak-blocks, accepted wallet payments that spend an earlier payment's unconfirmed change end neither confirmed nor in the miner's pool (matrix-paychain A/A on the tip stack 001-004: 4-12 lost in each of 10 runs, pr-scenario run 36647241843)

patches.title: Internal miner thread resumes after a rejected solution's nonce, not at the batch start + 1
patches.origin: ours (cafebedouin), not yet proposed upstream; candidate for a weak-blocks issue + PR
patches.fixes: after the candidate generator rejects an input solution (it no longer fits the cached candidate), the thread re-finds and resubmits the same nonce until a new candidate arrives
needed_by: rig matrix-compat (mixed networks): measuring Matrix miners' ordering-block share
patches.witness: ErgoMiningThreadSpec (fixed-hit fake PoW at nonces 5 and 900): red on 8769baace ('5 was equal to 5'), green with the patch (5 then 900); patch sha256 1edffd8a...; 2026-10-02
